end.summary:
Named circle parts using radius, chord, diameter, arc, segment and sector; some identifications were right but not steady yet.
Practised that a diameter is twice the radius and that a chord cannot be longer than the diameter; this was not steady yet.
Described rotation symmetry and practised reflection symmetry; some answers were right but not steady yet.
The circle symmetry mix-up continued: Dev gave four lines several times, then said infinitely many; this still needs checking.
end.parentNote: Asha practised circle vocabulary with pizza-slice and straight-cut examples, then used the diameter and triangle idea to compare chords. Dev connected diameter with two radii and stated that a chord cannot be longer than the diameter. The reflection-symmetry mix-up was not fully corrected after it reappeared; Dev later said “infinitely many,” so this needs checking next time. At home, ask Dev to draw a circle and mark several diameters, then discuss why every diameter is a line of symmetry.

Aap phir varg ki chaar rekhaen gin rahe hain. Gol roti mein kendra se guzarti rekha ko thoda sa aur tirchha kar dein, tab bhi modne par dono aadhe milenge; aise kon lagataar badal sakte hain. To vrutt mein sammiti rekhaen sirf chaar hain, ya anaginat?
सर, चार ही होती हैं ना! एक सीधी ऊपर-नीचे, एक सीधी दाएं-बाएं, और दो क्रॉस, जैसे स्क्वायर में...

Aap varg ki chaar rekhaen vrutt par laga rahe hain. Ab cricket ki gol gend par kendra se guzarti ek tirchhi rekha sochiye, jo un chaar se alag ho; us par bhi dono aadhe milenge. Agar rekha ko zara aur ghuma dein, to kya woh nayi sammiti rekha hogi?
अनंत... माने बहुत सारी, कितनी भी बना लो, बस केंद्र से होके जाए।

Haan, aapne baat pakdi: kendra se guzarti rekha ko jitna chahein ghuma sakte hain, aur har baar vrutt ke dono aadhe milte hain. Isliye sammiti rekhaen anaginat hain. Ab ek jeeva ko kendra se hatakar sochiye; kya woh phir bhi vyaas hogi?
